column1: # gate-lint-steps.tsv: the ONE table of the gate's seconds-long lint steps (AP-278, R42). Read by tools/gate-lint-first; tools/test_gate_lint_first.py checks every row
# against tools/check-all.sh. Columns (TAB): name, gate, command.
#   gate = step           -> check-all.sh has `step B <name> <command>` with exactly this command (the test compares them);
#   gate = inside:validate -> not a step of its own: tools/validate-repo.py runs it (the test greps validate-repo.py for the command).
#   command = [needs FILE] CMD...: with `needs FILE` the step is SKIPped (printed) when FILE is not in the checkout, as check-all.sh `needs` does.
# A row whose tool is not in tools/ yet (branch not merged) may lack its check-all.sh line; the test requires the line as soon as the tool file exists.

column3: needs tools/public-push-guard python3 tools/public-push-guard gate HEAD
